answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks fakes. Each identity stakes a 70-credit bond and registers a karst fingerprint, its work-timing map. Each epoch a fresh sample must match the map within 3%; the lotus gate opens only on a match. Copied samples, or scores at their nadir below threshold, burn the bond. First fingerprint 36, kth 36+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,531,500, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints fail; honest pays 36 once.
